summary: Frontend-only verification of bug fixes (Electron white screen, PWA install), new features (barcode scan in Kasir, Setting Barang & Stok upgrades), and quick regression. All 5 acceptance areas from the review request PASS. HashRouter fallback works on file:// (both /app/frontend/build/index.html and /app/desktop/app/index.html render EXAPOS login and login → dashboard). PWA static prerequisites (manifest, /sw.js registered, /icon-192, /icon-512, portable zip) all HTTP 200; the install button correctly does NOT render in headless Chromium because beforeinstallprompt is not fired (documented environment limitation, not a bug). Barcode scan matches by barcode and by legacy code, resets input, adds to cart, and shows 'tidak ditemukan' toast for invalid input. Setting → Barang & Stok now shows Barcode column (no Kode), low-stock badge filters to exactly the 3 expected products (Matcha Latte, Tumbler Exano, Hoodie EXA Signature) and toggles back, mass CSV upload inserts 'Produk Tes Upload' with success toast, bulk delete removes selected rows (21→19), and product form exposes product-form-barcode field. Web mode keeps clean URLs (no hash).
action_items: Optional: expose a 'select-all-rows' checkbox with data-testid=select-all-rows in the Barang & Stok header row (not required by spec but improves testability).

Optional: CSV template download did not fire Playwright's 'download' event (likely because it uses a Blob URL + anchor click without a real navigation download). Behaviour is likely correct in real browsers; if desired, verify manually or use URL.createObjectURL with an <a download> that triggers a navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js correctly guards HashRouter behind window.location.protocol==='file:' — good, keeps http/https on BrowserRouter and no hash pollution.

InstallPWA.jsx returns null unless beforeinstallprompt fires — that's correct PWA UX. Verified manifest+SW+icons all HTTP 200. Chrome installability criteria appear met based on static assets; end-to-end installability can only be confirmed on a real Chrome desktop.

seedData.js barcode field verified via table (e.g., 8990001000001..8990001000006 for physical). Migration on load appears to be working (existing seed already had barcodes populated after fresh reset).
test_credentials: exanoadm@gmail.com / Exano#2026! (Admin) — verified working via mock auth on both web (https) and file:// build.
seed_data_creation: Test cleared localStorage (exapos_*) to re-seed. After bulk-delete and mass-upload tests, executed localStorage.removeItem('exapos_products') + removeItem('exapos_products_v2') to restore seed on next reload. No persistent side-effects for user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testid is data-testid=login-username-input (not login-email-input). Setting page tabs are <button>s (use get_by_role('button', name='Barang & Stok')). PWA install button will not appear in headless Chromium — verify manifest/SW/icons via HTTP HEAD instead. Portable zip is served at /EXAPOS-portable-win64.zip, 116MB, content-type application/zip (do not full-download during tests; HEAD only). To simulate the Electron packaged app on Linux, open file:///app/frontend/build/index.html OR file:///app/desktop/app/index.html — HashRouter kicks in and app loads normally.
rca of the issue: BUG-1 (Electron white screen): Root cause was BrowserRouter calling history.replaceState in a file:// origin, which Chromium blocks with SecurityError (origin 'null'). Fix in App.js line 11 (const Router = window.location.protocol === 'file:' ? HashRouter : BrowserRouter) resolves it — file:// build now shows #/login and login works. BUG-2 (PWA install): Prior build lacked a UI affordance. New InstallPWA component listens for beforeinstallprompt and renders a button (data-testid=pwa-install-button) in Login page + sidebar. Prereqs (manifest with icons/start_url/display, /sw.js registered, 192+512 icons, https) are all in place. Headless Chromium does not fire beforeinstallprompt, so button not visible in automated test — this is expected environment behaviour, not a bug.
